activity.title: 找位置，再换一句
cloze: I put my books in my ______.
activity.oral: 把短文中的 ruler 换成 pencil，再用 under 或 beside 说两句。
activity.model: My pencil is under my book. My schoolbag is beside the desk.

activity.title: 重读卡片，检查句子
cloze: Use a ______ to find the meaning.
activity.oral: 给家人写一句英文祝福，检查开头大写、结尾句号。

activity.title: 把好习惯说给家人听
cloze: I wash my face in the ______.
activity.oral: 用 First, ... Then, ... 说清洗手、吃饭或收拾书包的顺序。
activity.model: First, I wash my hands. Then, I have lunch.

activity.title: 看日历，说明怎么出门
cloze: We wait for the bus at the ______.
Look at the ______ to find the date.
activity.oral: 说一说你星期六去哪里、如何去、需要带什么。
activity.model: I go to the park by bus on Saturday. I take a water bottle.

activity.title: 为一次出游选择衣物
activity.oral: 先重读第6篇；再用 I wear ... 和 I take ... 说出一身衣服和一件物品。
activity.model: I wear a jacket and trousers. I take my backpack.

activity.title: 在家演一演购物对话
cloze: Dad keeps his money in a ______.
activity.oral: 两人轮流当店员和顾客；至少问一次价格，再说一次试穿请求。
activity.model: How much is this jacket? May I try it on?

activity.title: 读动物故事，说照料办法
cloze: We say one sheep and two ______.
activity.oral: 选一种动物，用 It has ... 描述，再用 I can ... 说一件照料小事。
activity.model: The rabbit has long ears. I can give it clean water.

activity.title: 从菜园说到餐桌
cloze: I eat hot ______ with a spoon.
activity.oral: 用 We grow ... We pick ... We eat ... 连说三句，介绍一种食物。
activity.model: We grow tomatoes. We pick ripe tomatoes. We eat tomato soup.

activity.title: 小餐馆里再算一次
activity.oral: 给两样物品写一个模拟价格，用 plus 计算总价。
activity.model: The book is ten yuan. The pen is two yuan. Ten plus two is twelve.

activity.title: 饭后聊聊身体和习惯
cloze: I tell Mum when I have a ______.
I take my ______ with an adult's help.
activity.oral: 先重读第11篇；再用 I feel ... 和 I can ... 表达感受与一个健康习惯。
activity.model: I feel tired. I can go to bed early tonight.

activity.title: 把自己的暑假计划说出来
activity.oral: 用 I want to ... I can ... I promise to ... 说一个三句的小计划。
activity.model: I want to join the nature club. I can draw flowers. I promise to protect the park.

stories.title: 每件东西都有自己的位置
paragraphs: It is Monday. I walk into our classroom with my cousin Kele. There is a new desk and a small chair for him. He puts his schoolbag beside the desk. Then he opens his pencil case. His eraser is there, but his ruler is not. We look under the chair and behind his notebook.

At last, I see the ruler by the window. Kele smiles and puts it back. Before we go out to play, we turn off the light. Now every book and pencil has a place. Our room is tidy, and Kele is ready for his first lesson.
translation: 星期一，我和表弟小可乐走进教室。这里有给他准备的新课桌和小椅子。他把书包放在课桌旁边，然后打开铅笔盒。橡皮在里面，可是尺子不在。我们找了椅子下面和笔记本后面。
最后，我在窗边看见了尺子。小可乐笑了，把它放回原处。出去玩之前，我们关了灯。现在，每本书、每支铅笔都有自己的位置。教室整洁了，小可乐也准备好上第一节课了。

stories.title: 我们的单词游戏
paragraphs: Our class has a word game today. The first rule is simple: listen to your partner. I hand out the word cards. Everyone is ready. Zhiyan reads a question aloud, and Kele looks for the right picture. He finds it, but he drops some cards on the floor.

'Sorry!' he says. 'It is OK. We can help,' says Zhiyan. We pick up the cards together and put them in a tidy box. There is time for one more game. When the game is over, we turn off the fan and close the door. Kele wants to play again next week.
translation: 今天，我们班有一个单词游戏。第一条规则很简单：听搭档说话。我分发单词卡，大家都准备好了。芷嫣读出一个问题，小可乐寻找相应的图片。他找到了，但是把一些卡片掉在了地板上。
“对不起！”他说。“没关系，我们能帮忙。”芷嫣说。我们一起捡起卡片，把它们放进一个整洁的盒子里。还来得及再玩一轮。游戏结束后，我们关掉风扇，关好门。小可乐想下周再玩。

stories.title: 给奶奶的一张卡片
paragraphs: I want to write a card for Grandma. Zhiyan is my reading partner. First, we copy the date. Then I write a sentence about her garden. I start her name with a capital letter and put a full stop at the end. Zhiyan asks me to underline the words I know and circle one new word.
I do not know its meaning, so we use a dictionary. Now I can spell the word and say it aloud. We draw a flower on the card. Grandma reads it with a smile. A small card can carry a lot of love.

我不知道这个新词的意思，所以我们查了词典。现在，我能拼写这个词，也能读出来了。我们在卡片上画了一朵花。奶奶笑着读卡片。一张小小的卡片也能传递很多爱。

stories.title: 先把手洗干净
paragraphs: Kele finishes his homework and runs into the living room. There is a big peach on the table. 'Clean hands first,' Mum says. We go to the sink. We wash our hands, and Kele washes his face, too. We turn off the tap when we finish. The floor is wet, so we walk slowly to stay safe.

Back at the table, Kele shows me his loose tooth. 'Can I still eat the peach?' he asks. Mum cuts it into small pieces for him. We share the peach and talk about our day. Good habits help us enjoy little things at home.
translation: 小可乐做完作业，跑进客厅。桌上有一个大桃子。“先把手洗干净。”妈妈说。我们来到洗手池。我们洗了手，小可乐还洗了脸。洗完后，我们关好水龙头。地板湿了，所以我们慢慢走，注意安全。
回到桌边，小可乐给我看他松动的牙齿。“我还可以吃桃子吗？”他问。妈妈帮他把桃子切成小块。我们分享桃子，聊聊今天的事情。好习惯帮助我们享受家里的小快乐。

stories.title: 家里忙碌的早晨
paragraphs: The clock in my bedroom says seven. I get up and go to the bathroom. Dad is making breakfast in the kitchen. Mum is working in the study. I think they need a little help, so I put the cups on the table. Kele brings the bread and gives everyone a napkin.

After breakfast, we go to school together. When we go home, we tell Mum about our day. In the evening, I put my books in my bag before I go to bed. Tomorrow morning will be easier. A good day starts with small things that we can do ourselves.
translation: 卧室里的钟显示七点。我起床后去洗手间。爸爸在厨房做早饭，妈妈在书房工作。我想他们需要一点帮助，于是把杯子放到桌上。小可乐拿来面包，给每个人一张餐巾。
早饭后，我们一起上学。回家时，我们告诉妈妈今天的事情。晚上，我睡前把书放进书包。明天早晨就会轻松一些。美好的一天，从自己能做的小事情开始。

stories.title: 找到正确的公共汽车
paragraphs: It is Monday. Dad looks at the calendar. Today we are going to visit Grandpa. 'What time do we leave?' I ask. 'At nine,' Dad says. We walk to the bus station. There is a lot of traffic, so we use the crossing and wait for the green light.

A blue bus comes, but it is not our bus. Dad checks the number on the ticket. We need the red bus. Soon it comes. I find a seat beside Dad and put my bag on my knees. Now we are ready for the journey. Grandpa is waiting with a warm lunch.
translation: 星期一，爸爸看了看日历。今天我们要去看爷爷。“我们几点出发？”我问。“九点。”爸爸说。我们步行去公交车站。路上车很多，所以我们走人行横道，等绿灯亮了再过马路。
来了一辆蓝色公共汽车，但不是我们要坐的车。爸爸核对车票上的号码。我们要坐的是红色公共汽车。不久，它来了。我找到爸爸旁边的座位，把包放在膝盖上。现在，我们的旅程要开始了。爷爷正准备着热乎乎的午饭等我们。

stories.title: 陪爷爷买衣服
paragraphs: Mum, Grandpa and I go shopping for clothes. Our list is short: a jacket and a pair of trousers. I want to buy Grandpa a gift with my own money. One jacket is beautiful, but it is too expensive. A shop assistant shows us another one. It is not very cheap, but the price is good.

'What size do you need?' she asks. Grandpa smiles. 'May I try on this jacket?' It fits him well. I pay with Mum's help. The assistant asks, 'Shall I wrap it?' 'No, thank you,' Grandpa says. 'I want to wear my new gift home!'
translation: 妈妈、爷爷和我一起去买衣服。清单很短：一件夹克和一条裤子。我想用自己的钱给爷爷买一份礼物。一件夹克很漂亮，但是太贵了。店员给我们看了另一件。它不算很便宜，不过价格合适。
“您需要什么尺码？”她问。爷爷笑着说：“我可以试穿这件夹克吗？”夹克很合身。我在妈妈帮助下付了钱。店员问：“需要包起来吗？”“不用了，谢谢。”爷爷说，“我要穿着我的新礼物回家！”

stories.title: 一次农场旅行
paragraphs: We visit a farm with Dad today. I put water and a map in my backpack. The journey is short, and Kele talks all the way. At the farm, we see a horse by the gate and some sheep under a tree. A duck is swimming in the pond. Kele wants to take a rabbit home as a pet.

'Every animal needs a safe home and daily care,' Dad says. Kele thinks for a minute. 'Then I can help look after our cat first.' We draw the animals in our notebooks. Before we leave, we thank the farmer for a lovely day.
translation: 今天我们和爸爸参观一个农场。我把水和地图装进背包。旅程很短，小可乐一路说个不停。到了农场，我们看见大门旁边有一匹马，树下有几只羊。一只鸭子正在池塘里游泳。小可乐想带一只兔子回家当宠物。
“每个动物都需要安全的家和每天的照料。”爸爸说。小可乐想了一会儿：“那我可以先帮忙照顾我们家的猫。”我们把动物画在笔记本上。离开前，我们感谢农民让我们度过了美好的一天。

stories.title: 我们的小菜园
paragraphs: Grandpa has a little garden. We plant carrots in spring and water them when the soil is dry. Today he shows me a red tomato, a long cucumber and a big potato. There are also green peas, lettuce and tall corn. Every vegetable has its own shape and colour.

Kele wants to pick everything, but Grandpa says, 'Some plants need more time.' We choose the ripe tomatoes for lunch and leave the small green ones. I draw our garden in my notebook. Kele makes a little sign: 'Please look after the plants.' Our lunch tastes better when we know where it comes from.
translation: 爷爷有一个小菜园。我们春天种胡萝卜，土干了就浇水。今天，他给我看一个红番茄、一根长黄瓜和一个大土豆。菜园里还有绿色的豌豆、生菜和高高的玉米。每一种蔬菜都有自己的形状和颜色。
小可乐想把菜都摘下来，但爷爷说：“有些植物还需要更多时间。”我们挑了熟番茄做午饭，把绿色的小番茄留在枝上。我在笔记本上画菜园。小可乐做了一个小牌子：“请照料这些植物。”知道食物从哪里来，我们觉得午饭更香了。

stories.title: 一起准备晚饭
paragraphs: It is time for dinner. Dad is making vegetable soup, and Mum is cooking rice. I set the table. I put a plate and a bowl in front of each chair. Kele brings a fork and a spoon for Grandma. 'Please pass the salt,' Dad says. Mum helps Kele stir the soup slowly.

The food smells good. We take a little first, so we do not waste it. Kele wants more soup, and I pass him the jug of water too. After dinner, everyone helps clear the table. Cooking, eating and cleaning are easier when we work together. This is our happy family meal.
translation: 该吃晚饭了。爸爸在做蔬菜汤，妈妈在煮米饭。我摆餐桌，在每把椅子前放一个盘子和一个碗。小可乐给奶奶拿来一把叉子和一把勺子。“请把盐递过来。”爸爸说。妈妈帮助小可乐慢慢搅拌汤。
饭菜闻起来真香。我们先少取一些，这样就不会浪费。小可乐还想要些汤，我也把水罐递给他。晚饭后，每个人都帮忙收拾餐桌。一起动手，做饭、吃饭和收拾都会更轻松。这是我们快乐的家庭聚餐。

stories.title: 我们的模拟小餐馆
paragraphs: Kele and I open a pretend cafe in the living room. We make a menu for our family meal. Soup is five yuan a bowl, and a pancake is three yuan. Dad wants soup and a pancake. 'Five plus three is eight,' I say. I write the number on his paper bill and check it twice.

Grandma wants two bowls of soup to share with Mum. We double five to make ten. Kele puts more rice on one plate and less on another. Soon, everyone says, 'We are full!' We use paper money, but our smiles are real. Our little cafe is fun.
translation: 小可乐和我在客厅里开了一家模拟小餐馆。我们给家庭聚餐做了一张菜单：汤每碗五元，一个薄煎饼三元。爸爸要一碗汤和一个薄煎饼。“五加三等于八。”我说。我在纸账单上写好数字，核对了两遍。
奶奶要两碗汤，和妈妈一起喝。五加倍就是十。小可乐给一个盘子多盛一些米饭，给另一个盘子少盛一些。不久，大家都说：“我们吃饱了！”我们用的是纸币道具，可笑容是真实的。我们的小餐馆真有趣。

stories.title: 我们的暑假自然小队
paragraphs: I want to start a nature club in the summer holiday. Walking is good exercise and helps us stay healthy. I invite Zhiyan and Kele to join. First, we finish our homework. Then we take our notebooks and water bottles to the park with Dad. We look at a tree, a butterfly and some ants.

There is a plastic bag beside a flower. Dad helps us put it in the bin. We promise to protect the park and leave the plants where they grow. At home, we draw what we see. Our club has a simple rule: enjoy nature and look after it.
translation: 我想在暑假里建一支自然观察小队。散步是一种很好的锻炼，帮助我们保持健康。我邀请芷嫣和小可乐加入。我们先做完作业，然后带上笔记本和水瓶，和爸爸一起去公园。我们观察一棵树、一只蝴蝶和一些蚂蚁。
一朵花旁边有一个塑料袋。爸爸帮助我们把它放进垃圾桶。我们保证保护公园，让植物留在原来的地方生长。回家后，我们画下看到的东西。我们的小队有一条简单的规则：享受大自然，也照料大自然。

sentences.text: I want to start a nature club in the summer holiday.
Walking is good exercise and helps us stay healthy.
I invite Zhiyan and Kele to join.
First, we finish our homework.
Then we take our notebooks and water bottles to the park with Dad.
We look at a tree, a butterfly and some ants.
There is a plastic bag beside a flower.
Dad helps us put it in the bin.
We promise to protect the park and leave the plants where they grow.
At home, we draw what we see.
Our club has a simple rule: enjoy nature and look after it.
